subject: general
question: 7 teachers A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). B is fifth to the left of E. A is fifth to the left of G. D is third to the left of E. C is second to the right of D. Who are the immediate neighbours of A?
solution:
Given: Seven teachers A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing north.

B is fifth to the left of E.

D is third to the left of E.

C is second to the right of D.

A is fifth to the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c516b18256cb285d7a76fb6bd542fc5adb994a2b6917e17381c8b50ed843b1d2.png] 

Immediate neighbours of A are B (left) and D (right).

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
